title: Product linear threshold function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega$ be a finite type, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\{\pm1\}$. The function $f$ is a product linear threshold if there are real weights $a_{i}(\omega)$ for each coordinate $i$ and symbol $\omega$, and a real bias $a_0$, such that for every input $x$, $f(x)$ is the threshold sign of $a_0+\sum_{i=1}^n a_i(x_i)$.
